name: 8f5c14ff086b
claim: A leaf signed from a CSR via openssl x509 -req does NOT inherit the CSR subjectAltName; the SAN must be re-asserted in the -extfile, and a CN-only leaf fails Python ssl hostname verification for IP connections (IP address mismatch) even when the chain verifies perfectly.

decisions.notes: First renewed leaf verified chain-only and passed; the peer flush then failed IP address mismatch because the extfile omitted subjectAltName; re-issue with SAN in the extfile cleared it.

rationale: SAN belongs in the signing extfile, not just the CSR; test hostname verification with the exact address the peer dials, not the chain alone.
